steps.title: Analyze Build Error
steps.description: Inspect the compilation log to locate the symbol lookup error in ReportsActivity.java.

steps.title: Fix Layout Content View
steps.description: Modify ReportsActivity.java to replace the invalid reflective check on R.style with a standard layout resource reference.

steps.title: Verify Style Constants
steps.description: Confirm that style XML layouts do not have reflective Java bindings to avoid future build breaks.

steps.title: Validate Activity Layout
steps.description: Ensure the layout file activity_reports.xml is correctly referenced and contains standard view groups.

steps.title: Check Database Helper Integration
steps.description: Confirm DatabaseHelper reports methods are properly linked to ReportsActivity query requests.

steps.title: Check Java 8 Compatibility
steps.description: Ensure no Java 9+ features or modern syntax structures are used in the modified Java source code.

steps.title: Verify Manifest Definitions
steps.description: Confirm ReportsActivity remains registered with standard styles in AndroidManifest.xml.

steps.title: Validate Companion Activities
steps.description: Scan other custom activities like MainActivity, SalesActivity, and AddEditProductActivity to ensure no matching style references exist.

steps.title: Check Gradle Settings
steps.description: Verify namespace, SDK settings, compile targets, and Java compile options in build.gradle.

steps.title: Building Inventory & Sales Manager
steps.description: Trigger the Gradle compilation framework to assemble the application without compile issues.
